g.text: Graph revision AD - in01: Agitator: shaft D24 with 4-blade 45 deg PBT D133 (PVDF per design.material) at 358 rpm; 0.09 kW gearmotor shown as its purchased envelope (plan rule 6)

Graph revision AD - in01: Q3 coil: PVDF DN15, 3 tube rings R 155 at 33 mm pitch per the design heat row (graph HL-Q3-A/B-HX6); the schedule N1/N2 service text says jacket - carried verbatim, the coil is the issued construction (hold, W12)
Graph revision AD - in01: The node internals row is none: the tracker records no internal solid; the agitator and coil are node-design machine features, drawn as solids
